decision: accept background polling with a final cancellation checkpoint before result commit
problem: follow_processing polled the complete processing future on the UI executor; synchronous decode setup, provenance hashing and saving can occupy that executor after native inference
implementation: reuse the existing GPUI BackgroundExecutor to own the processing future; continue consuming job events and the final result on the UI executor; keep the existing JobRuntime and repository protocol

redGreen.executor: real GPUI test-dispatcher is_main_thread reports true before the fix; false both before a pending interval and after resumption with the fix
redGreen.lateCancellation: a controlled provider returns its successful inference result after cancelling its context; before the checkpoint Workspace returned success and wrote results, afterwards it returns Cancelled and leaves the complete document/markdown unchanged
redGreen.ownership: the existing busy-until-future-exit test remains; its obsolete expectation that cancellation still writes results is replaced with Cancelled plus exact original document equality
redGreen.preflight: first test compilation used the method form of VisualTestContext.background_executor instead of its field; corrected before actual red execution

review.method: independent read-only source/diff and lifecycle review after the initial implementation
review.fixedFinding: moving polling off the UI allows a cancellation during synchronous provenance work; Workspace needs a token check after hashing and before repository admission
checks: processing future and output already satisfy Send; no new thread pool or scheduler
the background Task stays owned by the event-following loop and is not detached separately
the UI continues to own entity updates progress and completion notices
success results remain local until commit admission; cancellation preserves existing files and processing history
after commit admission the original repository write is allowed to finish; no interruption of atomic replacement
in-flight workspace ownership is retained until the processing future exits
no changes to model selection inference providers checksums or persisted result schema

sources.inspectedLocalSource: crates/gpui/src/executor.rs and platform/test/dispatcher.rs in the pinned zui checkout

limits: executor and persistence boundary behavior tested; no measured FPS or UI wall latency claim
fake providers exercise lifecycle and do not prove inference or audio quality
cancellation waits for the current synchronous checksum work to return to the checkpoint
no guarantee of aborting a repository transaction after it has been admitted
